newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot natgas boosted late by B.C. outage.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas boosted late by B.C. outage.

text.p: Western Canadian natgas prices turned softer early Friday, but an unexpected cut in supplies renewed the market's strength in the afternoon, industry sources said.
"Prices were softer, but then Westcoast declared a force majeure at Fort Nelson, and prices starting going back up," a Calgary-based trader said.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub was quoted early at C$1.57 per gigajoule, but as news of the force majeure surfaced, prices rose into the mid-C$1.60s.
Westcoast was not immediately available to comment on the status of the 750 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) gas plant.
